France Enacts Eco-Law Against Fast Fashion; China Objects

France has implemented a new law targeting ultra-fast fashion retailers, imposing environmental penalties and fees on companies like Shein and Temu. China has urged France to halt the law, claiming it constitutes discrimination and threatening unspecified countermeasures. A source from the French Ministry of Foreign Affairs rejected China's claims, stating they were false. The law aims to address the environmental impact of the fast fashion industry.
